hypothesis: W-R46 confirmed a partial order-balanced synthetic paired signal with serious source-family heterogeneity (affine ~49%, quadratic ~55%, xorshift ~70%). Under the SAME 1728 paired example budget and fixed 16-weight no-bias readout, development exposure split evenly across three source families could improve worst-family heldout performance relative to affine-only training, at possible cost to best-family results.
freeze: Freeze disjoint development seeds2560..2575, sealed heldout2576..2607 (32), 3 source families, nine entities, train-only sites2/5/8, amplitudes1/2, two heldout swap sites10/12, identity-only development/XOR55-invariant heldout, 32 epochs LR0.1. Compare affine_only 9 entities per seed vs mixed_three_sources 3 seed-rotated entities per source, resulting 1728 labelled paired comparisons per arm. Both-order genuine-first and genuine-second scored, tie half-credit; no source family identity input at inference.
arms: affine_only: 16 seeds x9 entities x3 sites x2 amplitudes x2 orientations=1728 examples, all affine_prior
diverse_mix: 16 seeds x3 families x3 entities selected by entity%3==(source_index+seed)%3 x3 sites x2 amplitudes x2 orientations=1728 examples; exactly576 per generator
primary: DIVERSITY_MINIMAX_GAIN iff diverse_mix weakest heldout generator balanced accuracy exceeds affine_only weakest by >=0.05, diverse_mix overall >=0.55, and no individual family decreases by >0.05 versus affine_only. PARTIAL_GAIN iff weakest increases >=0.02. NO_GAIN otherwise. Report full generator transfer, training updates, per-seed confusion and tie, identity/XOR55 equality and negative outcomes.
controls: Exactly equal examples and two-order signed labels per arm; fixed 16 weights no intercept, 32 epochs and matching-feature state, but generator mix and entity sampling differ by design and training update counts may differ
Family identity is evaluator stratification only and never input to trained scorer. Both models see two candidates; not a standalone classification capacity
New 32-seed first-use heldout; no W-R46 sealed reuse, no threshold selection after first use. Fold/test cluster dependence is disclosed
Original evidence archived, Go test/build, no accepted-ref mutation or scientific promotion/production authority
claim_limit: Synthetic supervised generator-mixture transfer among previously known deterministic families under explicit two-candidate comparison, not source-born real-world or language learning.
